metaDescription: Oriental Shorthair vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Oriental Shorthair boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Oriental Shorthair social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Oriental Shorthair exposure.
Weight range 7-14 lb (3-6.5 kg) and grooming needs (Short coat.) belong in the same Oriental Shorthair household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Oriental Shorthair is also monitored for amyloidosis risk, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Oriental Shorthair appointments.
After the Oriental Shorthair puppy/kitten series, keep adult FVRCP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Oriental Shorthair shots when the kitten seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or dental disease worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Oriental Shorthair make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Oriental Shorthair antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Oriental Shorthair dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium cat.
Reset the Oriental Shorthair reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Oriental Shorthair core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Oriental Shorthair misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Oriental Shorthair health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Oriental Shorthair adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
